[[File:TDL_Nanny_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A [[TDL nanny droid]]]]
A '''nanny droid''', '''child care droid''', or '''minder droid'''<ref name="Loyalties">{{JournalCite|4|Loyalties}}</ref> was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] specifically built and programmed for the care of children. Many nanny droids were covered with [[Synthflesh/Legends|synthflesh]], which mimicked the mother's scent and warmth. Also standard in nanny droid design was an internal reservoir that could hold [[Milk/Legends|milk]]. Child care droids were one of the four primary classifications of [[Class three droid/Legends|Class three droid]]s.

The earliest attempts at creating nanny droids were failures, with customers complaining about a lack of warmth from the units. However, they appreciated the droid's ability to keep order and a tight schedule.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Some nanny droids, such as [[Nanna]], were equipped with weaponry to defend their charges if the need should arise.
